turns.question: What is the pre-existing disease waiting period on an individual plan?
turns.standalone_question: What is the pre-existing disease waiting period on an individual plan?
turns.answer: The pre-existing disease waiting period on an individual plan is 36 months of continuous cover [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period], [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#how-the-waiting-period-is-checked]. This applies to individual plans, including Silver and Gold [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period], [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#how-the-waiting-period-is-checked], but note that the Senior plan has a different waiting period [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#senior-plan].

turns.question: Does moving from Silver to Gold restart that count?
turns.standalone_question: Does moving from a Silver individual plan to a Gold individual plan restart the 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period on the individual plan?
turns.answer: Moving from a Silver individual plan to a Gold individual plan does not restart the 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period on the individual plan [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period]. The months are counted from the first policy start date with Saffron Shield, in completed months. This information is specific to individual plans, including Silver and Gold [02_Waiting_Periods_Individual_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period], [03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#moving-to-an-individual-plan], and applies to all Saffron Shield plans [01_Claims_Process_Overview.md#the-four-adjudication-facts].

turns.question: And for group plans?
turns.standalone_question: Does moving from a Silver individual plan to a Gold individual plan or switching to a group plan restart the 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period on the health insurance policy?
turns.answer: The context provided does not directly address the waiting period for individual plans or switching from an individual plan to a group plan [03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period], [03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#how-the-waiting-period-is-checked], [03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#initial-waiting-period]. However, it does specify the waiting period rules for Corporate Group plans, which have a 12-month waiting period for pre-existing diseases.

summary: For individual Saffron Shield plans, including Silver and Gold, there is a 36-month waiting period for pre-existing diseases that starts from the initial policy date and continues uninterrupted even if the customer upgrades their plan. In contrast, Corporate Group plans have a 12-month waiting period for pre-existing diseases. The waiting period rules for switching from an individual plan to a group plan or for other types of group plans are not specified in the provided context.
